journey.name: Navigation drawer opens, navigates and closes with Back
journey.description: Start: the Mailflare v2 inbox is open and signed in (in Chrome or the installed app). On phones the folder list is a drawer opened from the menu button at the top left.

actions.action: Tap the menu button (three horizontal lines) at the top left of the screen
Verify that a drawer slides in from the left listing "Inbox", "Starred", "Snoozed", "Sent", "Drafts", "Archive", "All mail", "Spam" and "Trash", with "Settings" and "Switch to classic" at the bottom
Verify that the drawer does not show "Keyboard shortcuts"
Verify that the drawer is closed and the list heading reads "Sent"
Tap the menu button at the top left of the screen to open the drawer again
Press the Android Back button once
Verify that the drawer is closed and the list heading still reads "Sent"
